_⚠️ Potential issue_ | _🟡 Minor_

**Add a blank line before the new heading.**

MD022 requires headings to be surrounded by blank lines; insert an empty line between the prior paragraph and the new “2025-05-28” heading.  


<details>
<summary>✅ Suggested fix</summary>

```diff
 **Prevention:** Enforce strict rules against committing debug endpoints. If needed, they must be behind a strong authentication (e.g., admin-only or dev-environment only checks). Use feature flags or ephemeral debugging tools instead.
+
 ## 2025-05-28 - Unauthenticated Cache Debug & Debug Directory
```
</details>

```
In @.jules/sentinel.md around lines 5 - 6, Insert a single blank line

& Debug Directory" so the new heading is separated from the previous paragraph;
update .jules/sentinel.md by adding one empty line above that heading to satisfy
MD022.
```
